part.label: Cable Tie Anchor Strip
part.description: A base strip with two identical tie-down posts, each with a through hole for a cable tie. Both posts are authored once as a local sub-assembly and placed with group-level position/mirroring, instead of duplicating and hand-mirroring each component's position.

components.description: Tie-down post; authored at the sub-assembly's own local origin, on top of the base. The group below moves the whole sub-assembly into place.
Tie-down post; authored identically to post_left at the sub-assembly's own local origin. The group below mirrors the whole sub-assembly instead of this needing hand-mirrored coordinates.

features.description: Cable tie pass-through hole in the left post.
Cable tie pass-through hole in the right post.

groups.description: Left tie-down sub-assembly, moved as a unit to its position along the strip.
Right tie-down sub-assembly, mirrored from the left sub-assembly across the YZ plane instead of re-specifying its position.
